description: VN 'liên hệ với' transfer: learners calque 'với'=with onto the transitive verb contact ('contact with me'). Rule en-vietlish-contact-with drops 'with' (mirrors en-step6-marry-with) ONLY when 'contact' is a VERB immediately followed by 'with' + a person pronoun. A negative lookbehind blocks the NOUN sense ('in/keep/lose/make contact with him'), where 'with' is correct.
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. 'with' is correct after the NOUN 'contact' (in/keep/lose/make contact with) and with non-person objects. V1 fires only on a finite VERB form of 'contact' + 'with' + person pronoun; the lookbehind locks out every noun reading. Negatives: the 'in contact with' noun phrase, 'made contact with', a no-'with' sentence, and a non-contact verb.

positive.notes: Modal + base verb 'contact' + 'with him' -> drop with.

positive.input: She contacted with us last week.
We are contacting with them now.

negative.input: I am in contact with him.
negative.expectedCorrection: I am in contact with him.
negative.notes: Noun 'contact' (lookbehind 'in') -> 'with' is correct, must abstain. (Precision lock.)

negative.input: Please keep in contact with me.
negative.expectedCorrection: Please keep in contact with me.

negative.notes: Verb 'contact' but no 'with' -> must not fire.
No contact verb (work + with is correct) -> must not fire.
